summary_en: This study tests an investigational drug called RO7656594 in people with advanced or metastatic prostate cancer. The drug is taken by mouth on specified days in 28-day cycles, and the dose is raised in successive groups of participants until a study-specific threshold is reached. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the body processes the drug (pharmacokinetics), and preliminary activity; it is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba un medicamento en investigación llamado RO7656594 en personas con cáncer de próstata avanzado o metastásico. El medicamento se toma por vía oral en días específicos de ciclos de 28 días, y la dosis se aumenta en grupos sucesivos hasta alcanzar un umbral definido por el estudio. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el cuerpo procesa el medicamento (farmacocinética) y la actividad preliminar; es un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: ECOG performance status of 1 or lower
Metastatic prostate adenocarcinoma without small-cell carcinoma or neuroendocrine features
Prior treatment with a second-generation androgen receptor-targeted therapy
Prior taxane treatment, or considered ineligible for or refused a taxane
If BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutation is known: prior PARP inhibitor, or considered ineligible for one
not_for: Approved systemic anti-cancer therapy within 14 days or 5 half-lives (whichever is longer, up to 28 days) before first study treatment
Investigational agent within 28 days before first study treatment
Previous androgen receptor protein degrader treatment
Untreated central nervous system metastases or leptomeningeal disease
